pins.title: Spalling concrete, slab edge
pins.body: Carbonation-driven reinforcement corrosion at the exposed slab edge. Break-out, treat and reinstate; cathodic-risk detailing at exposed edges.

pins.title: Water ingress, planter membrane
pins.body: Recurring leaks from planters over habitable rooms. Failed membrane and inadequate falls confirmed by targeted opening-up.
pins.ref: Membrane replacement · revised falls and drainage

pins.title: Cracking, masonry movement
pins.body: Stepped cracking consistent with differential movement. Monitored, measured and traced to cause before rectification is designed.
pins.ref: Cause established before fix is specified

pins.title: Failed termination, upstand
pins.body: Membrane stops short of the required upstand height at the façade junction. Water enters behind the finish and tracks to the tenancy below.

pins.title: Ponding — falls to drain
pins.body: Measured falls below the minimum gradient leave standing water against joints after rain. Falls re-established in the remedial design.

pins.title: Sealant failure, movement joints
pins.body: Aged sealant debonded at movement joints. Cut out and re-sealed with detailing matched to the joint width and movement class.

pins.title: Ceiling staining below roof junction
pins.body: Staining maps the entry path from a roof junction above, not the fixture beside it. Confirmed by moisture readings and opening-up.

pins.title: Efflorescence at slab soffit
pins.body: Salt deposits mark long-term moisture movement through the slab. Source addressed first; cosmetic repair last.

pins.title: Corroded fixings, wet area
pins.body: Fixings corroding in a persistently damp zone. Replaced with the correct durability class once the moisture source is resolved.
